requirement.title: Customer Product Cart Addition - Blue Top
requirement.description: Verify that a customer can add the Blue Top product to the shopping cart successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: Locate Blue Top product on catalog and click Add to cart.
Confirmation modal appears with Added! message.
Cart table displays 1 row with Blue Top, unit price Rs. 500, quantity 1, total Rs. 500.
Modal continuation retains item in cart upon later navigation.
Multiple additions increment quantity without duplicate rows.

scenarios.title: Add Blue Top product to cart and verify cart item details
scenarios.objective: Verify single-item addition of Blue Top from catalog and accurate cart item details
testSteps: Locate and hover Blue Top card
Assert cart table displays exactly 1 row with Blue Top, price 500, qty 1, total 500
expectedResults: Item details match: Blue Top, price 500, qty 1, total 500
assumptions: Blue Top is available as Product ID 1 at Rs. 500

scenarios.title: Add Blue Top and continue shopping, verifying item is retained in cart
scenarios.objective: Verify modal dismissal via Continue Shopping retains item in cart upon later navigation
testSteps: Verify modal is hidden and user remains on catalog
Navigate to cart via header Cart link
Assert Blue Top is retained in cart with qty 1 and total 500
expectedResults: Cart preserves Blue Top with qty 1, total 500
assumptions: Session cart persists across page navigation

scenarios.title: Adding Blue Top multiple times increments quantity in cart
scenarios.objective: Verify re-adding Blue Top increments quantity without creating duplicate table rows
testSteps: Add Blue Top to cart and click Continue Shopping
Add Blue Top to cart a second time and click View Cart
Assert cart table contains exactly 1 unique row
Assert quantity is 2 and total is 1000
assumptions: SUT merges identical items by incrementing quantity
